entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: A plane whose story is retold in the in-world work RAVNICA! The Musical.

entities.name: Maze's End
entities.description: The place where the runners end their strife, according to RAVNICA! The Musical.

entities.name: Guildpact
entities.description: A role that a hooded kid becomes 'for life' at Maze's End, per RAVNICA! The Musical.

entities.name: Griselbrand
entities.description: A raging being who was bound in a vault, according to INNISTRAD! The Musical.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker who came asking what was in Griselbrand's vault, per INNISTRAD! The Musical.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: A plane whose story is retold in INNISTRAD! The Musical.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: A planeswalker blessed by Heliod who stepped up against a hydra, per THEROS! The Musical.

entities.name: Heliod
entities.description: A god of Theros who blessed Elspeth.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: A plane whose story is retold in THEROS! The Musical.

entities.name: Eldrazi titans
entities.description: Two titans that fell and set the ground rumbling, per ZENDIKAR! The Musical.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: A plane whose story is retold in ZENDIKAR! The Musical.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: A planeswalker dragon who flew off grumbling that no one ever listens, per ZENDIKAR! The Musical.

entities.name: Dr. Julius Jumblemorph
entities.description: A mad scientist whose work's necessity is often questioned.

entities.name: Cornelian
entities.description: An inventor with a hundred failed patent applications who designed a gnome with scoops for hands.

entities.name: X
entities.description: A figure determined to find out what a pigeon knows.

entities.name: S.N.E.A.K.
entities.description: A spy organization with a Code and a secret headquarters, whose acronym is given many expansions.

entities.name: Agent 47.3
entities.description: An agent bound by the S.N.E.A.K. Code who must make sure her target is dead before looting.

entities.name: Zarv
entities.description: A hireling who no longer trusts kitten posters telling him to 'hang in there.'

entities.name: Lucinda
entities.description: A schemer who enjoys science, squirrels and maniacal laughter.

entities.name: Martha
entities.description: An assassin who poisoned a target and refolded the napkins in two minutes.

entities.name: Skrab
entities.description: A goblin who tried to warn his fellows that a hammer was bait for a trap.

entities.name: Flaky the Irrational
entities.description: A villain who wants to put the 'die' in 'diameter.'

entities.name: Ig
entities.description: A goblin who, with Burf, discovered a technique by accident.

entities.name: Burf
entities.description: A goblin who reached for his hammer and missed, discovering a technique with Ig.

entities.name: Wildspeaker Ranch
entities.description: A ranch with a long championship lineage of beasts.

entities.name: Crossbreed Labs
entities.description: A hybridization laboratory with a campus that houses creatures such as the rhinopus.

entities.name: Phoebe
entities.description: The head of S.N.E.A.K., named on her card.

entities.name: Baron Von Count
entities.description: A villain who taunts that doom has no snooze button.

entities.name: Krark
entities.description: A goblin who would lose his thumb in a wager and come back with 'Double or nothing!'

entities.name: The Big Idea
entities.description: A self-styled brains of the operation who lobs brains at foes.

entities.name: Order of the Widget
entities.description: An order that doesn't believe in traveling light.

entities.name: League of Dastardly Doom
entities.description: A villainous league that takes the word 'headquarters' very seriously.

entities.name: Goblin Explosioneers
entities.description: A goblin group for whom there's no crater like home.

events.summary: As told in RAVNICA! The Musical, the runners end their strife at Maze's End and a hooded kid becomes Guildpact for life.
events.quote: Our saving grace, that hooded kid, is now Guildpact for life.

events.summary: As told in INNISTRAD! The Musical, Griselbrand is bound, until Liliana Vess comes asking what is in the vault.
events.quote: 'Til Lili Vess came 'round asking, "Hey, what's in the vault?"

events.summary: As told in THEROS! The Musical, Elspeth, blessed by Heliod, steps up against a hydra and burns those who attack her.
events.quote: Elspeth, blessed by Heliod, stepped up where the hydra trod.

events.summary: As told in ZENDIKAR! The Musical, two Eldrazi titans fall and Ugin flies off grumbling.
events.quote: The two Eldrazi titans fell and set the ground a-rumbling!

events.summary: Cornelian, after a hundred failed patents, designs a gnome with scoops for hands.
events.quote: He immediately designed a gnome with scoops for hands.

events.summary: Skrab tries to warn his fellow goblins that the hammer is bait, but they stop listening.
events.quote: Skrab tried to warn his fellow goblins that the hammer was bait for a trap, but they stopped listening at "hammer."

events.summary: Ig and Burf discover a technique by accident when Burf misses his hammer.
events.quote: Ig and Burf discovered the technique by accident when Burf reached for his hammer and missed.

relations.quote: Elspeth, blessed by Heliod, stepped up where the hydra trod.
The S.N.E.A.K. Code clearly permits looting corpses for parts.
